targets.trial_name: AVANZAR · 专利与 Agent 对照
targets.endpoint: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) by blinded independent central review (BICR) in the non-squamous TROP2 biomarker positive population
targets.population: Previously untreated advanced non-squamous NSCLC, TROP2 biomarker positive, without actionable genomic alterations.
targets.comparison: Dato-DXd 6 mg/kg + durvalumab + carboplatin versus pembrolizumab + histology-specific platinum chemotherapy.
targets.success_definition: First official decisive primary analysis reports a favorable statistically qualifying PFS result by BICR in the non-squamous TROP2 biomarker-positive population under the prespecified SAP. Other populations, OS, unadjusted nominal p-values, commercial decisions and delayed readouts do not resolve this target. If multiplicity-adjusted qualification is unclear, adjudication remains unresolved.
targets.analysis_timepoint: First officially reported decisive analysis of the specified primary PFS hypothesis; registry timeframe approximately 3 years.

evidence.title: AVANZAR registered design
evidence.text: Randomized open-label phase III AVANZAR, total enrollment 1350. There are four primary hypotheses: PFS and OS in non-squamous TROP2-positive and overall non-squamous populations. This target is only the TROP2-positive non-squamous PFS hypothesis. Alpha allocation, event counts, biomarker prevalence and missing-data estimand are not supplied. Registry estimated primary completion 2027-11 does not establish readout timing.

evidence.title: TROPION-Lung01 indirect randomized evidence
evidence.text: In previously treated non-squamous NSCLC, Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel showed PFS HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51–0.79), subgroup n=229 versus 232. This is indirect evidence: later-line versus first-line, monotherapy versus triple combination, different comparator, and no isolation of the target TROP2 biomarker-positive population. It is not an AVANZAR treatment effect. Source was previously archived as a primary-reader excerpt, not a full paper download; no independent human review.

evidence.title: 一期 DS-1062a 研究中的未确认客观缓解率
evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.

protocol.purpose: Separate preregistered operational patent and workflow pilot, one asset, not independent replication or a full season.
protocol.selection_policy: Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash represent two families with valid structured responses in pilot. Engineering-compatibility selection, not outcome-based model superiority; all four initial records retained.
protocol.primary_selection: First attempt per slot. No retry or silent response replacement. Shared-agent track uses a review call followed by a forecast and is scored separately.
protocol.patent_contrast: Exact same clinical packet, prompt, requested model, configuration and budget within this cohort; only selected reviewed patent added.
protocol.scientific_limit: Two AI-role patent checks share a base model, zero independent human reviews; early unconfirmed ORR cannot be treated as phase 3 efficacy.
protocol.pricing_status: Unpriced token-bounded pilot; pricing page requires login; actual invoice amount unknown.
protocol.independent_timestamp: RFC3161 FreeTSA before calls and after outputs; trust pinned third-party CA, not legal notarization.
protocol.evaluation: Score only a matching future adjudicated primary endpoint; preserve all failures/abstentions and independent-asset count=1. No success-rate claim.
